# Whisker moderator accounts
# Managed via server console. Do not edit while server is running.
# Format: username:password:role
#
# Create accounts from the server console:
#   addmod <username> <password> [role]
#
# Available roles are defined in roles.toml.
# If no accounts are listed here, the server falls back to
# the legacy single-password auth in moderation.c3.
